transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Okay, Monday morning, sixteenth. Let's get going, we're a bit behind. Everybody has coffee? Good.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Yes, yes. Um, I've got the CAD open, I can share.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Let's start with the components. Priya, where are we?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: So, um, the case in CAD is mostly there. The curve works. The scroll wheel sits at the top third, then the power button above it.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Can we, um, talk about the LCD? Because last time we, we left that open.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Right. The little display to show the channel.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Yeah. From a user point of view it's nice but it's expensive.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: It's four euros of the twelve fifty. Just the display.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Four? That's a third of the budget.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: So, drop it?

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Yeah. Yeah, drop it. People look at the TV for the channel anyway.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Agreed.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Agreed. Saves me a hole in the case too.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Right, LCD is out. Decision made.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Oh, and the colour. Marketing feedback came in, the, um, yellow is the number one choice.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Yellow, with the rubber? That could actually look good.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: As long as the icons stay readable. Black on yellow is fine.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: So yellow case, rubber finish, everyone fine?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Fine.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Great. Yellow it is.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: I'll ask the supplier whether they can do a yellow dye on the rubber. I think it should be fine, but I'm not certain they stock it, so, I'll try.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Do we put a power button on the front too, or just the top one?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: One's enough. The top.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Single power button on top, agreed? Okay, good.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Mm, one other thing. We could add a backlight for the buttons, maybe, for the dark living room thing.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Oh yeah, people like that.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Backlight means LEDs, means another battery drain, plus cost.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Yeah. I don't know. Maybe we should look at it. Someone.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: I won't assign it, it's a nice-to-have. Let's note it as an idea.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Sure.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Right. Let's talk about cost, because I've seen the numbers and I'm a bit worried. Priya, can you give me the, um, bill of materials?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: I'll send it right after this meeting.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Thanks. I'll check the component costs against the budget by Wednesday and tell you where we stand.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Wednesday the eighteenth?

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: The eighteenth, yes.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: So for the CAD, um, I'll finish the CAD drawing of the case by Friday. I think that's realistic.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Friday the twentieth, great.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Okay. And the user manual. Who does that? It's, it's, we need a draft for the evaluation.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: I think that's you, Leo, isn't it? Because it's closest to the interface.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Yeah, okay, I'll write the user manual draft.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: I can do it too, I've, um, I've done a few for the earlier product.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Oh, okay, Hannah, you would take the manual then? That works, you have the template.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Yeah, I'll take the manual draft.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Oh, hm. Okay. So we're both on it?

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Hmm. Let's, let's sort it out offline. Between you two.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Fine.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Yep.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Actually, sorry, can I come back on the CAD? I said Friday but the, the software licence is down on Friday for maintenance. So, it'll be Monday the twenty-third.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Hmm. Okay. Monday the twenty-third then, for the CAD.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Yes, Monday.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Alright, I'll, hm, I'll write down both and we check on the Friday.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Sorry, what's the CAD going to be Friday or Monday?

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Monday. Well, Friday if the licence works.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Okay, leave it.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Did the building people confirm the lab?

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Oh. The usability lab, for the evaluation next week. Um, I haven't heard. Who is going to arrange the usability lab for next week?

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: I thought you, Sam.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: I thought maybe marketing.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Mm, no.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: It's not a UI thing.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Okay. Unclear.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Maybe it's the secretary who books rooms.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Could be. Let's, let's see.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Did you see the weather this weekend?

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Don't get me started. I was soaked.

transcript.speaker: Sam Whitaker
transcript.text: Ha. Alright, if there's nothing else, let's close. Thank you, everyone.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Thanks.

transcript.speaker: Hannah Cole
transcript.text: Bye.

transcript.speaker: Leo Brandt
transcript.text: Bye.

decisions.text: The case colour is yellow with a rubber finish
Drop the LCD display from the design
Ship with a single power button on top
